metrics.hook: A pollock model can change what an AI's apparent advantage means.

criteria.name: Hook / scroll-stop
criteria.reason: Inside the fold and substantively true, but apparent advantage is abstract. The following publication-date sentence adds context rather than immediately sharpening the catch-versus-breeding-stock tension.

criteria.name: Point of view / take
criteria.reason: Clear earned position: scenario-specific gains create alternatives worth testing, and learned and predefined rules deserve evaluation against the same explicit goals. This is a defensible judgment rather than only a paper summary.

criteria.name: Substance & specificity
criteria.reason: Names the publication date, eastern Bering Sea pollock, affiliated center, learning feedback, predefined comparison, both biological cases and management institutions. Explains spawning biomass and makes its reversal concrete.

criteria.name: Readability & restraint
criteria.reason: 1497 characters lies in the preferred band; short paragraphs and a separate definition support scanning. No decorative formatting. Recruitment remains mildly technical but its second-case relationship is stated plainly.

criteria.name: Engagement design (CTA + comment-bait)
criteria.reason: The closing balance question invites substantive discussion and follows directly from the two simulated outcomes. It could elicit more concrete criteria but is neither generic nor manipulative.

criteria.name: Brand voice & accuracy
criteria.reason: Alaska and AI relevance are integral. Credits demonstrated policy discovery while clearly limiting operational inference. Separate comparisons are preserved; no profit, deployment, bycatch improvement or proven catch-stability claim.

criteria.name: Hashtag craft
criteria.reason: Four true-to-topic end tags cover technology, place, industry and species. Logical broad-to-niche mix; exact follower-count bands were not independently measured, so no popularity or reach claim earns extra credit.

decision: PASS for this exact post; the hook has room to sharpen but no substantive correction is required.

source_precision.editorial_inference: The first-case stock advantage does not automatically generalize, and equal explicit goals are the appropriate further comparison. These are reasoned interpretations of the verified separate outcomes, not additional measured benefits.
source_precision.source_placement: Sources properly remain outside post.txt under the Phase6B comment-block contract. Exact paper/date and claims remain traceable in sources.json.
source_precision.c17: Public-code availability is not claimed in this post and need not be added solely because the narration includes it.
source_precision.precision_limits: Scoring checks the post against the existing independently verified claim set; no numerical results were reproduced and no LinkedIn hashtag follower totals were verified.

optional_improvements.detail: The opening could name the changed biological assumption or the catch-versus-breeding-stock reversal more directly. Any revision requires a new lint and score tied to the new hash.
